title: feat(lint): warn when a select option colour renders neutral on the option badge
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAoNwrZVJoUEFfvMURpRPKJ)_
Fixes #37435
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：搭建者（人或 AI）给下拉选项写了 teal、amber、大写的 Red 这类界面画不出来的颜色时，校验命令和保存时都会收到一条提示，说明这个颜色会显示成灰色、该怎么改；写九个色系名或十六进制色的不受影响。
- 为什么做：上一张卡已经定下"选项颜色只认作者声明、没配就灰"，但写错的颜色也会静默变灰，作者不知道自己写错了。
- 出错会怎样：只是提示、从不拒绝保存，误报最多多一条警告；平台和示例里现有的选项颜色没有一条会触发，可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

- New advisory rule `field/option-color-renders-neutral` (`lintOptionColors` in `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`). It warns on a select option `color` the option badge does not paint: anything that is not one of the nine palette families (`gray red orange yellow green blue indigo purple pink`, lowercase, as `BADGE_COLOR_MAP` matches them) and not `#` + 3 or 6 hex digits. The warning names the option; the fix line names the spelling the value already points at (lowercase family, the hex with its `#`, the hex without alpha digits), otherwise the families and the hex form. It never maps a colour name to a family.
- Route (a) as a warning, not (b) a name-to-family map: (b) is consumer-side tolerance that invents a colour the author did not pick, close to the value-derived colour ruling A on #36882 removed (「A 全部去掉，没配就灰」). Not a refusal: `SelectOption.color` stays `z.string()`, and charts and gantt bars paint a CSS colour name.
- Registered in `AUTHORING_RULES` as `tier: 'advisory'`, on `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint`, and on the runtime publish gate for `object` and `object_extension` writes, where findings ride back as 2xx `advisories` (the save door Studio, REST `/meta` and MCP authors share). Judges object fields, object-extension fields, picklists and picklist extensions; picklists are CLI-only because `picklist` is not runtime-creatable.
- `os explain field/option-color-renders-neutral` entry in `rule-explanations.ts`, with the measured per-surface reading.
- Root barrel publishes `FIELD_OPTION_COLOR_RENDERS_NEUTRAL`, `OPTION_COLOR_FAMILIES`, `isBadgePaintableOptionColor`, `lintOptionColors`, type `OptionColorPicklist`.
- Object and object-extension door roster pins gain the rule (three test files), and the four docs CLI transcripts print 87 author-time rules (`check:docs-transcript-drift`).

## Tests

- New pin `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.option-color-37435.test.ts`: `teal` warned (rule, severity, path, where, fix names all nine families) and `amber`, `Red`, bare hex, alpha hex, `rgb()`, `hsl()`, leading-space hex all warned; every declared family and `#abc` / `#14b8a6` not warned; blank colour not judged; extension and picklist paths; all three commands; at the save door `teal` comes back as an advisory with zero errors, and `red` / a hex with none.

## Acceptance notes

- Door crossing: this is an advisory-tier rule at the object door. The five fenced advisory rules (#4716 adjudication, `RUNTIME_OBJECT_ADVISORY_VOLUME`) stay fenced and untouched; that fence prices advisory VOLUME. Measured volume for this rule: 0 firings. Census of option-level colour literals: objectstack at 6e11ff2b (`*.object.ts`, picklists, extensions; non-test) is every one a family name or a 6-digit hex; the only out-of-family names (`teal`, `amber`, 9 sites) are OBJECT-level `color`, which this rule does not read. hotcrm at 08a7451: 170 colour literals, all 6-digit hex. The one out-of-family option colour in the tree is a test fixture (`ui/e2e/list-condition-row-35549.spec.ts:87`, `amber`).
- Single source of the family list: `@objectstack/lint` cannot import `@object-ui/fields` (lint depends on spec only and runs in the kernel's save door), and a lint test reading the renderer source would need a `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` + `turbo.json` declaration outside this claim's file surface. The list is therefore spelled once in lint (`OPTION_COLOR_FAMILIES`) with a comment naming `BADGE_COLOR_MAP`; the shared home both sides could read is `@objectstack/spec`, left as an open question in the report rather than taken here.
- Not judged: a form view's own option list, and an object extension's `fieldPatches`.
- The runtime advisory has no localized `userMessage` (no `.user-text.ts` catalog); Studio renders the English `message`.

## Verification

- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/data-model-rules.option-color-37435.test.ts` → 9 passed.
- Read first: `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` (`isBadgePaintableOptionColor`, must match the renderer's reading), `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` (the `lintOptionColors` entry and its door comment), `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (the per-surface paragraph).

<details><summary>Local readings (HEAD after the docs commit)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` → Test Files 244 passed (244), Tests 9816 passed, 5 skipped; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (tsc + test layer) green.
- Ablation: `isBadgePaintableOptionColor` forced to `true` on disk → 5 of 9 pins red (the out-of-family pin included); restored with `git checkout HEAD`.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/project-thread-ciejge` → `VERDICT clean exit 0`, #37929 (shares `rule-explanations.ts`) merges cleanly.
- Derived gate families run locally; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` are NOT MEASURED here (no full build; shallow clone) and are left to CI.

</details>
